body:
You can FEEL the energy rolling through the streets of downtown Austin like a melody. It’s a little bit country, a little bit rock and roll, an unspoken commitment to being a home for uniqueness and creativity. The self-proclaimed “Live Music Capital of the World”, Austin is a celebration of time-tested togetherness woven through with innovation, new ideas, and reinvented ways of being.

Just like your family, Austin is a mash-up of what has been and what will be – a collection of moments remembered and moments waiting to begin.

We knew that if we were going to introduce a collection named after this unapologetically funky city, it would need to be beautiful enough to be worthy of every lullaby, good night kiss, and cuddle you’re waiting to share. It would need to have an artistic identity all its own AND a chameleon quality that would allow it to suit just about any nursery.

So we started with the basics - beautifully finished beech wood that brings a bit of the natural world into a clean modern aesthetic or slides seamlessly alongside more traditional décor. Crafted by the same fine furniture makers we’ve trusted since 1932, our contemporary Austin 3-in-1 Convertible crib is made in Italy with sustainable materials and non-toxic finishes. It’s durable, beautiful, and safe for tiny teethers, persistent bouncers, and the snooziest of sleepers.

The only other thing the Austin 3-in-1 Convertible Crib needed to live up to its name was the perfect duet partner.

You asked, we listened, and the Austin 5-Drawer Dresser was born. Extra deep drawers for storage that exceeds expectations, reliable stability, quiet-close construction for those fragile nap silences, and the lead and phthalate free finishes and anti-tip hardware that keep your family safe. The Austin Dresser’s contemporary white drawer faces are accented with beech wood pulls and rubberwood dresser legs that create perfect harmony with its crib counterpoint. But don’t limit this dresser to the nursery! It’d be just as at home hiding art supplies in a studio, alongside a mid-century dining set, or anywhere else you need a little extra space.

Austin is a city of storytellers, songwriters, and possibilities. We can’t wait to hear about all the stories, songs, and memories you and your little one will share in the Austin Collection.
